en.title: Maximum Sum of Median Throughputs over Groups of Three
en.description:
Each group has three servers, and a group's throughput is the median of the three. Each server joins at most one group, and some servers may go unused. Find the maximum total throughput over all groups.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains the throughputs. 1≤n≤200000, 1≤throughput≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 9, 4 and 0. With fewer than three servers no group can be formed.
hints: After sorting, at most floor(n/3) groups can be formed. Repeatedly take two servers from the largest end; the smaller of the two contributes the median, then give the group one of the smallest remaining servers.
